title: Lisbon to Paris, 12 May 1903: the coded sentence
caption: The 14 code groups of King Carlos's telegram of 12 May 1903 (ANTT PT/TT/CAM/M12, image m0054) between its clear French words, with the Portuguese the Hotel Bristol card m0060 puts in their place.
key_note: From targets/carlos1903/m0054_decryption.txt. 38564 = ter and 58215 = com are fixed by the two repeats, which stand where 'ter ... com' repeats in the decode; 29955 = combinado and 49452 = fallado follow from them. 82042 = Governo francez is inferred. Groups 1-4 and 8-10 carry 'Po-des dar mas só depois de' and 'Ros-a e ella' between them, but which group carries which word is not known; their tiles show the phrase on the first group and are marked uncertain. Only 14 groups exist, fewer than the usual 40.
